title: Mixed Event — Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show! — Episode2 Here Comes Our Helper!

meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!
meta.Event Outline: After successfully wrapping up their ambassadorial performances, Wonderlands×Showtime is preparing to put on a New Year's show at the new and improved Wonder Stage. Unfortunately, Lion Dance Robot seems to be feeling a bit under the weather...

rows.Line: The next day -  New Year's Eve
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We're back at the Wonder Stage following the conclusion of our ambassadorial performances...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But we haven't been receiving the same sort of stimulation as before.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Of course, I couldn't be happier to be back at the Wonder Stage making the audience smile. This is our home and there's plenty we can still do here.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I want more of those opportunities...
I want to keep growing as an actor.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I could conceivably train with some other troupes to hone my craft... But...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm the troupe leader of Wonderlands×Showtime. I can't just leave because I feel like it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You care deeply about doing your best as a cast member of Phoenix Wonderland and making your own dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Both things, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! It's already this late...?!
I need to get to practice!
A few hours later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And so, Tsukasanosuke and his merry group of friends continued to make everybody all across the land smile. The end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, our final rehearsal went beautifully. We should be more than ready for tomorrow's performance...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's make it a super happy New Year's for everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, let's!
A happy performance to kick off the new year!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You've been awfully quiet today...
Just yesterday you were running all over the place.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Shall I run a check?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa! You scared me!
Also, check? Check what...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In simple terms, she'll be running a diagnostic check on him to make sure he's functioning properly.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean she can figure out if Lion Dance Robot's sick...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Understood.
Commencing diagnostic check.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Check complete.
No issues detected.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Really?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Yes.
However, if I were to put my finger on it...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: He seems to be feeling a little down.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
Lion Dance Robot's feeling sad?! Why?! Our show's tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, a robot can feel sad...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It could be because our show is tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Lion Dance Robot seemed very happy when I brought him out of storage the other day since he usually only gets to come out and play around New Year's.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I suspect that he's feeling a bit down because he knows that he'll have to go away for a while after tomorrow's performance...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, let's make it so he gets to appear in shows all year round! Not just during New Year's!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, it's so much fun to do all sorts of shows in all sorts of different places!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
True...
As much I'd like to do that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I built Lion Dance Robot with a fairly specific purpose in mind. Unfortunately, his functions are limited, so it may be difficult to make him more versatile.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
But...

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In other words, Lion Dance Robot would look very out of place if he were to perform in a show that's not about New Year's...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He may be a robot, but it does seem like he wants to be in more shows...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He may even stand to gain quite a lot if we were to somehow make that possible for him...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, why don't we try performing in a variety of different places outside of the Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
A wide variety of places?!
That sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You mean starting now? How are we gonna do that? It's New Year's Eve, and we need a way to transport Lion Dance Robot and Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'd also have to receive permission to perform wherever we go. That's going to take a bit of time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
R-Right... Wait, I know!
Emu, can't we ask your brothers for some help?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
They could help us get permission to perform!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, hang on... They're gonna be busy attending all these New Year's parties and stuff, so they might not be able to help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr...!
Then, we just have to find someone else who can...
Oh, are you all done rehearsing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Sis...? Emu, is she your big sister?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I do remember hearing that she has an older sister...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's nice to meet you all.
I'm Emu's big sister, Hinata.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You must be Tsukasa, Nene and Rui. I've been meaning to meet all of you for quite some time now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
L-Likewise!
We are honored!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, Sis, what are you doing here? Did you need something?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, I was actually hoping to use your New Year's show as reference for something.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our show? As reference...?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Yes, I'm studying how to make it so children can have more fun while learning.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: As it turns out, I'll be doing some field training at a preschool and putting on a little performance for the children there.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: So, since you're very popular with children, I was hoping to have them see your show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Thank you for explaining.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Not a problem. But I seem to have missed my opportunity since you've already finished practicing...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: At the same time, I'm glad I came since I got to overhear a lovely conversation.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You were just talking about doing shows in various different places, no? I'd like to help you with that, and I can drive if need be.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
S-Sis...!
Thank you! This is so wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A-Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Of course! Not only do I want to see your show, but I'd also love to help out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much!
Then, we happily accept!
